title: dactylis glomerata f. capitellata
intro: Dactylis glomerata f. capitellata, commonly known as orchard grass, is a type of flowering plant in the grass family (Poaceae). This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include relief from fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The health benefits of Dactylis glomerata f. capitellata are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
